title: Average query cost
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree with outputs in $\alpha$. Its auxiliary average cost is the product-distribution mean of its query count on inputs whose coordinates are independently sampled according to $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with $n$ input coordinates
